subject.title: fix(update): keep gateway healthy during concurrent updates

question: Must this head produce live launchd/systemd/Task Scheduler evidence before merge, or may the focused concurrency tests and exact-head CI receive an explicit proof override?
rationale: Repository policy requires after-fix real behavior proof for external runtime PRs, but the contributor documents that no approved supervisor host is currently available; only a maintainer can accept that residual availability and state-ownership risk.

options.title: Require managed-service proof
options.body: Provide an approved supervisor host and capture redacted output showing concurrent requests launch one updater, only one restart continuation runs, and the Gateway returns healthy.

options.title: Approve a proof override
options.body: Explicitly accept the focused tests and green exact-head CI as sufficient for this head despite the missing real supervisor run.
